description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katakubura, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320254 (23/0861)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (Parcel Nos. 6:1, 6:2, 55, 56, and 58) in Kandy District, including detailed particulars of landowners, property extents, and title classifications. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including land registrations, property ownership, and land titles, which aligns perfectly with Type 4 (Land Gazettes) classification.
